Chapter 6888: Time For A Change In Leadership

Chapter 6888: Time For A Change In Leadership

Since the summoning horn was sounded, shouldn’t Immortal Emperor Gu Chun be here as well? Otherwise, what was the point of his role?

“Please come and save us during this existential crisis!” Immortal Devourer roared again.

The crowd exchanged glances, aware of how he was forcing the situation. Nevertheless, logic was on his side.

“Leader, please fight with us.” One of the ten Vagrant Immortals said.

“Please fight with us!” Some overlords joined in.

“This is pointless. Gu Chun is definitely not in Stygian, he abandoned us long ago.” Mirage said.

“Hah, as I always said, we can’t rely on outsiders.” Extinguish uttered coldly.

“It’s fine to not be around under normal circumstances, but he has to be here with us right now.” Fire Immortal said.

“That is correct.” Big-foot and Southconch agreed.

“Abolish his position and expel him! He heartlessly abandoned us and is no longer qualified to lead Stygian.” Immortal Devourer said.

“Nonsense.” God Messenger swung his heavy sword and caused devastating quakes: “Is this a rebellion?”

“I will devour all dissenters.” Devouring Lord spoke.

“How are we wrong when the irresponsible is the leader? This is for the sake of the alliance.” Immortal Devourer said.

“Dark Realm must hand its authority over. From now on, Devouring Alliance will no longer be under its rule.” Fire Immortal said.

“We agree.” Extinguish and Mirage stepped forward.

“Dark Realm will no longer be in charge.” Big-foot and Southconch did the same.

“We need a leader during a crisis.” One of the ten Vagrant Immortals said.

“I see.” God Messenger’s six eyes glared at them.

“This is not the time for infighting, gentlemen.” Controller said.

“We will obey as long as Gu Chun is here.” Immortal Devourer said: “Otherwise, I will be the first to consider him ineligible for the position.”

Everyone could see that Immortal Devourer and Fire Immortal wanted to take over the alliance again.

“You two do not get to decide.” God Messenger said.

“This isn’t something that can be determined trivially.” Controller said.

“I’ll just devour whoever wants to have a new leader.” Devouring Lord remarked with his dreadful mouth.

Dark Realm’s members couldn’t just watch the two do as they pleased.

“Then Dark Realm wishes to oppose the entire alliance? No brothers are willing to support someone who cares so little about them.” Immortal Devourer said while staring at the crowd.

The crowd exchanged glances. Although Dark Realm was strong, the emperor was not here.

“This is a special occasion, we need a leader.” One vagrant immortal said.

“Dark Realm has to hand its authority over to someone else.” Mirage said loudly.

“It doesn’t matter, Dark Realm will remain in charge. I will kill any dissenter.” God Messenger said.

“Don’t be viewed as traitors now.” Devouring Lord said.

“Devouring Abyss will be the first to refuse this injustice.” Immortal Devourer said.

“Fallen Ten agrees.” Mirage said.

“It’s time for a change in leadership.” Fire Immortal added.

“Is this how it’s going to be?” Controller activated his immortal aura, shaking all of Stygian.
